title: The canonical successive integral and finite-field scalar mate
statement:
Fix a prime $l$ and a finite intermediate field $E$ of the fixed algebraic closure. For every scheme $T$, name the canonical ordinary unbounded derived scalar extensions $L_T$ from the pulled condensed integers of $E$ to its pulled condensed field and $Q_T$ from that field to the finite-subextension-valued pulled condensed algebraic closure [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]. For a scheme morphism $g:U\to V$ and an unbounded internal integral complex $C$, define the actual arrow
$$Q_V(\lambda_{g,C})\mathbin{;}\beta_{g,L_U(C)},$$
where $\lambda$ is the published integral localization/direct-image comparison [lem-sfb-localized-direct-image-comparison] and $\beta$ the published finite-field-to-closure derivedPushHom [def-sfb-derived-push-hom]. Semicolon means first the left arrow and then the right arrow. Its source is $Q_V L_V Rg_{*,\mathcal O_E}(C)$ and its target is $Rg_{*,\Omega}Q_U L_U(C)$. No properness, boundedness or invertibility is imposed. The module records proved aliases for the canonical closed symmetric internal-module tensor and its colimit, coherence and flat-resolution interfaces; localization exactness is the existing result [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell]. These aliases do not change any tensor, scalar functor or comparison.

source.place: Formal properties: compatibility of mates with coefficient-map composition; integral-to-field and finite-field-to-algebraic-closure cases. This names their actual composite to share the derived-functor structure arguments.

def nativeScalarCondensedComposite (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (C : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) U))) :
    (nativeScalarClosureDerived V l E).obj
        ((nativeScalarIntegralDerived V l E).obj
          ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
            (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) g).obj C)) ⟶
      (CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
        (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) g).obj
          ((nativeScalarClosureDerived U l E).obj
            ((nativeScalarIntegralDerived U l E).obj C))
